item.title: Pennsylvania officials report state's 3rd death involving measles
item.description: A Pennsylvania woman's death is the state's third this year involving the measles virus

item.title: Japan’s biomass energy boom threatens further deforestation in Indonesia
item.description: Expanding deforestation in Indonesia caused by the country’s wood pellet and chip industry is putting further pressure on tropical forests, Key Biodiversity Areas, and Indigenous territories in the archipelago, according to new satellite analysis from Indonesia-based nongovernmental organizations

item.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO’s call to curb China's AI development
item.description: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has hit back at a call from the head of Anthropic for the U.S. to curb China’s artificial intelligence capabilities

item.title: Josh Allen connects with Joshua Palmer for a late TD and Bills beat Texans 36-31 in wild opener
item.description: Josh Allen threw a 34-yard touchdown pass to Joshua Palmer with 1:36 remaining to lift the Buffalo Bills to a 36-31 win over the Houston Texans in a back-and-forth season opener

item.title: Team captain Angela Stanford rues missed putts by Americans and slow greens at the Solheim Cup
item.description: Team USA's Solheim Cup performance was marked by two extraordinary putts but it fell short overall on the slow greens at Bernardus Golf

item.title: Referees body admits 'error of judgment' after Haaland goal against Man United
item.description: The governing body of Premier League referees has admitted an “error of judgment” after Erling Haaland’s hotly contested goal settled the 199th Manchester derby

item.title: Mouthfeel joins flavor as a food industry focus to satisfy consumers craving extra texture
item.description: Want more crunch when you munch or goo when you chew

item.title: Africa's biggest oil refinery opens to public ownership, sparking excitement among retail investors
item.description: Aliko Dangote, Africa's richest man, is opening a portion of his refinery to public ownership in Africa's biggest initial public offering

item.title: Amazon suspends use of 21 Air, the cargo carrier whose plane careened off Miami runway and killed 5
item.description: Amazon says it has suspended its partnership with 21 Air after one of the cargo carrier’s planes careened off a Miami runway last week and killed five people

item.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after visiting dignitaries passed through
item.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through

item.title: North Korea says its recent live-fire drill demonstrated 'huge destructive power'
item.description: North Korea says it has conducted a joint live-fire drill involving missiles, artillery and drones that it claimed demonstrated “the huge destructive power of concentrated fire.”

item.title: Trump has support in Doonbeg, though tiny snails have snagged his Irish golf course plans
item.description: President Donald Trump's visit to Ireland has attracted protests, but in one corner of the country there is strong support

item.title: Indonesia intensifies search effort for 129 people missing after ferry capsized in Java Sea
item.description: The search for survivors of a capsized ferry in Indonesia has intensified as 17 ships and aircraft from the military, police and other agencies were deployed

item.title: Trump calls on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel, citing a global shortage
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has called on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel infrastructure, saying attacks are causing a global shortage

item.title: New warnings about the risks of AI to humanity revive a long-running debate
item.description: New warnings from the artificial-intelligence industry have revived debate over whether advanced AI models could escape human control and threaten humanity
